KyoubeAI 1.17 lets Claude and other assistants work with your data tables and apps.

## What's in 1.17.0

**Assistant connections are KyoubeAI's own.** The core's MCP server is now served at `/mcp/kyoubeai`, with every tool named `kyoubeai_*` and given a title. Claude, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other MCP clients sign in with OAuth, and you approve each connection in KyoubeAI for one company. A connection acts as you and never has more access than you do. An instance admin turns it on under **Settings → Experimental → Assistant connections (MCP)**; it needs an `https://` address, or `localhost` for a client on the same machine. The guide is [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/mcp.md).

**Data tables and apps.** 25 new tools sit beside the core's tasks, agents, projects and skills: list, query and change tables and rows, run read-only SQL, and create, publish, roll back and archive apps. Each is in a read, write or configure tier, your own Kyoube data level and groups still decide every call, and a refusal comes back to the assistant with its reason. The core's two catch-all API tools are gone.

**Add to Claude.** The setup page has a section for Claude on the web, Desktop and mobile, with a link that opens Claude's custom connector form with KyoubeAI filled in. `kyoube doctor` prints the same link once assistant connections are on.

**How it was tested.** On a fresh instance on `localhost`, the official MCP TypeScript SDK client signed in with OAuth (dynamic client registration, authorization code with PKCE, a loopback callback), with the consent approved in a headless browser as the signed-in person. It listed 60 tools, each with a title and a read-only or destructive hint, none named `paperclip` and no catch-all tools. It then listed tables, created a table, inserted and queried a row, and created and published a draft app; each write left an `mcp.tool_called` entry in the activity log. Claude Code 2.1.322 added the server with `claude mcp add` and reported it as needing authentication. A signed-in check from Claude Code itself is still to do.

## Update

From 1.16, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.16.0 from that backup. The core and its database are unchanged, and `kyoube.apps` moves to 0.15.0 on the next start. If you connected an assistant at `/mcp/paperclip`, connect it again at `/mcp/kyoubeai`: the old address answers 404 ([docs/upgrading.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/upgrading.md#moving-to-117)).

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
